questions.q: Which opening is correct for a formal letter to a newspaper editor?
questions.why: Spanish letters use dos puntos after the greeting, and a formal register.

questions.q: What earns the highest reading marks in directed writing?
options: Repeating the ideas of both texts in order
Using only the more convincing text
Copying key sentences from the texts
Evaluating and developing ideas from both texts
questions.why: Examiners reward ideas from both texts that are evaluated, not just repeated.

questions.q: Which is the best opening for a speech to a school assembly?
options: Buenos días, señora directora, profesores y compañeros:
questions.why: A speech addresses the audience directly in a register suited to them.

questions.q: Text A says: «Todos los jóvenes prefieren estudiar con música.» Write one sentence in Spanish that evaluates this idea.
questions.model: Es una generalización sin pruebas: el texto no cita ningún estudio y seguramente no es cierto para todos los jóvenes.
points: judges the idea (generalización / exagerado / sin pruebas)
